scene whensummerends1
: Twenty-three!
lines.zh: 二十三！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: : It’s where we are!
lines.zh: 这就是我们所在的地方！

lines.en: : I figured it out!
lines.zh: 我算出来了！

lines.en: : How long have I been here?
lines.zh: 我在这里多久了？

lines.en: scene whensummerends2
: I knew it wasn’t twenty-two because twenty-two is gone. And twenty-four is wrong, so twenty-three is right! I did a good job!
lines.zh: 我知道不是二十二，因为二十二已经没了。而二十四也不对，所以二十三是对的！我干得不错吧！

lines.en: : Yasu, how long have I been here?
lines.zh: Yasu，我在这里多久了？

lines.en: scene whensummerends3
: Since all of this began.
lines.zh: 从这一切开始的时候。

lines.en: : I don’t mean at the party. I mean right here in front of you. When did I get here and where was I beforehand?
lines.zh: 我不是说在派对上。我是说就在你面前。我是什么时候到这儿来的，来之前我又在哪儿？

lines.en: : If you’re going to use your inexplicable brain powers for anything, use them to help me right now because I {i}need it.{/i}
lines.zh: 如果你那莫名其妙的脑力能派上什么用场，就现在用它来帮我，因为我{i}需要{/i}。

lines.en: : You’ve been right in front of me all along. It’s just that you’ve been everywhere else as well and I’m too focused on Him to keep track of your every move.
lines.zh: 你一直都在我面前。只是你也同时在别的所有地方，而我太专注于祂，没法追踪你的每一步。

lines.en: scene whensummerends4
: But He is sleepy now. And His season has come to an end.
lines.zh: 但祂现在困了。而祂的季节已经走到了尽头。

lines.en: : Summer isn’t over yet. Everything still feels wrong. It’s supposed to go back to normal when the seasons change. I’m supposed to be fixed.
lines.zh: 夏天还没结束。一切都还是不对劲。季节变换的时候本该恢复正常的。我本该被修好的。

lines.en: scene whensummerends5
: I’m afraid that isn’t possible anymore.
lines.zh: 恐怕那已经不可能了。

lines.en: : Unless you’re willing to destroy yourself and rebuild from the ground up.
lines.zh: 除非你愿意毁掉自己，从零开始重建。

lines.en: : The whispers of the world have turned to laughter. And they aim their jokes at you — the one they call the child of makeshift deities. But it is in complete disregard of the fact that there is but {i}one{/i} deity.
lines.zh: 世界的低语已经变成了大笑。它们把玩笑对准你——那个被称作「拼凑之神的孩子」的人。但这完全无视了一个事实：神{i}只有一位{/i}。

lines.en: : Then...
: Then come with me. I’ll give you my “light.” I’ll take something that doesn’t belong to me.
lines.zh: 那就跟我走。我把我的「光」给你。我会拿走一件不属于我的东西。

lines.en: : Oh...you poor, little lamb.
lines.zh: 哦……你这可怜的小羊羔。

lines.en: : Your light’s already burnt out.
lines.zh: 你的光早就烧尽了。

lines.en: : You have nothing I want or need anymore.
lines.zh: 你已经没有任何我想要或需要的东西了。

lines.en: scene whensummerends6
: But when the world shifts again and His power dawns once more, you will be reassessed! And then, if you pass all of His tests, your light could come back. Doesn’t that sound wonderful?
lines.zh: 但当世界再次转动、祂的力量再度降临时，你会被重新评估！到那时，如果你通过了祂所有的考验，你的光也许会回来。听起来是不是很美妙？

lines.en: : Yasu...what is happening to me?
lines.zh: Yasu……我到底怎么了？

lines.en: scene whensummerends7
: You’ve been a bad boy.
lines.zh: 你一直是个坏孩子。

lines.en: : You broke too many rules when all you had to do was spread yourself out.
lines.zh: 你本该做的只是把自己摊开，可你破了太多规矩。

lines.en: : Now, like a plague, it will be your {i}misery{/i} that swarms the land in place of your seed.
lines.zh: 如今，像瘟疫一样，将是你的{i}痛苦{/i}而非你的种子，成群地席卷这片土地。

lines.en: : And all of us are doomed to crumble beneath you as you fall and you flail and forget who you are.
lines.zh: 而当我们都在你之下崩塌时，你会坠落、挣扎、忘记自己是谁。

lines.en: : Was it worth it in the end?
lines.zh: 到头来值得吗？

lines.en: : Did you have a good time?
lines.zh: 你玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Did you make some happy memories?
lines.zh: 你留下了一些快乐的回忆吗？

lines.en: scene whensummerends8
: If you did, then write them down.
lines.zh: 如果有，那就把它们写下来。

lines.en: : Look back on them years from now, long after your mind has been purged of the darkness you’ve invited in.
lines.zh: 多年以后回望它们，在你脑海中那些被你招来的黑暗早已被清除之后。

lines.en: : Look back on them and {i}remember...{/i}so you won’t make the same mistakes again.
lines.zh: 回望它们，然后{i}记住……{/i}这样你就不会再犯同样的错。

lines.en: scene whensummerends9
: May I act as your shepherd one last time, Svarog? Before the party ends and all of our doubts are washed away by the rain?
lines.zh: Svarog，在派对结束、我们所有的疑惑都被雨水冲走之前，我能最后再做一次你的牧羊人吗？

lines.en: : Can I? Please?
lines.zh: 可以吗？求你了？

lines.en: : Do whatever you want, Yasu...
lines.zh: 你想做什么就做什么吧，Yasu……

lines.en: : I don’t get it anymore.
lines.zh: 我已经不懂了。

lines.en: scene whensummerends10
: Then leave everything to those who do.
lines.zh: 那就把一切交给懂的人。

lines.en: : For even the most lost, unfortunate souls will one day find their way back to Him. And I trust that you will accept this in your heart when the rest of your options have expired.
lines.zh: 因为即便是最迷失、最不幸的灵魂，终有一天也会找到回到祂身边的路。而我相信，当你的其他选项都耗尽时，你会在心里接受这一点。

lines.en: : We live in a beautiful world — even if it is so often polluted by those who don’t understand.
lines.zh: 我们活在一个美丽的世界——即便它常常被那些不懂的人污染。

lines.en: : But you don’t {i}need{/i} to understand to make your time here feel good. And if you know there’s not much left, why let the fear of the unknown spoil what remains?
lines.zh: 但你并不{i}需要{/i}理解，才能让你在这里的时光感觉美好。既然你知道剩下的不多了，为什么要让对未知的恐惧糟蹋掉所剩的一切？

lines.en: : If I were you, I would enjoy my final moments.
lines.zh: 如果我是你，我会享受最后的时光。

lines.en: : I would spend them with the people I cherish.
lines.zh: 我会把它花在我珍视的人身上。

lines.en: : And you don’t realize how lucky you are to have so many of them.
lines.zh: 而你不知道，自己能拥有这么多这样的人，有多幸运。

lines.en: : Was it worth it in the end?
lines.zh: 到头来值得吗？

lines.en: : Did you have a good time?
lines.zh: 你玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : And did you make some happy memories?
lines.zh: 还有，你留下了一些快乐的回忆吗？

lines.en: : Ah! There she is.
lines.zh: 啊！她在那儿。

lines.en: : Because I did.
lines.zh: 因为我有。

lines.en: : And it would be nice if you did too.
lines.zh: 如果你也有，那就太好了。

lines.en: scene whensummerends11
: I swear, letting you into the manga club was like taking on a permanent escort quest. And one that never ends at that. How do you keep disappearing without anyone even noticing?
lines.zh: 我发誓，让你进漫画社简直就像接了一个永远做不完的护送任务。而且还是个没有尽头的。你到底是怎么做到每次消失都没人注意到的？

lines.en: : It helps that I’m an insignificant husk of a girl who no one would mind chopping into pieces and adding to a hot pot.
lines.zh: 多亏我是个无足轻重的空壳女孩，没人会介意把我剁成块丢进火锅里。

lines.en: : What a strangely specific form of self-deprecation.
lines.zh: 多么奇特又具体的自贬方式啊。

lines.en: : You have been gone for quite a while, Harold.
lines.zh: 你消失了相当长一段时间，Harold。

lines.en: scene whensummerends12
: {i}Herald,{/i} Kafka. Herald.
lines.zh: {i}Herald{/i}，Kafka。是 Herald。

lines.en: : Harold Shipman of Bestwood Estate, husband to Primrose Oxtoby and licensed general practitioner.
lines.zh: Bestwood 庄园的 Harold Shipman，Primrose Oxtoby 的丈夫，有执照的全科医生。

lines.en: : Did you and Yasu have a secret meeting where you just decided to become creative all of a sudden? What in the bloody hell is going on right now?
lines.zh: 你和 Yasu 是不是偷偷开了个会，突然决定要变得有创意起来？这到底是在搞什么鬼？

lines.en: : You weren’t looking for me, were you?
lines.zh: 你们不是在找我吧？

lines.en: : If I say that I was, will you assume it means that I have fallen in love with you? Because the mere thought of that makes me want to swallow fire.
lines.zh: 如果我说是在找你，你会不会因此以为我爱上你了？光是想想就让我想去吞火。

lines.en: scene whensummerends13
: She’s obviously kidding, Sir. Kafka’s costume is just a little too tight in certain areas and it’s causing her to act a bit-
lines.zh: 她显然是在开玩笑，先生。Kafka 的戏服有些地方实在太紧了，弄得她有点-

lines.en: : Hey, sorry to interrupt, but have any of you guys seen Io around here? She kind of just...disappeared without saying anything.
lines.zh: 嘿，打扰一下，你们有人看见 Io 吗？她就这么……一声不吭地消失了。

lines.en: scene whensummerends14
: Ahh, yes. The Irish goodbye. Or, as they call it where I come from — goodbye.
lines.zh: 啊，是的。爱尔兰式告别。或者，用我们那儿的说法——再见。

lines.en: : Is disappearing without saying anything unusual for her? I had assumed that was simply how she operated.
lines.zh: 一声不吭地消失对她来说不寻常吗？我还以为她本来就是这么行事的。

lines.en: : She normally says something to {i}me{/i} at least. And she’s not answering her phone either.
lines.zh: 她平时至少会跟{i}我{/i}说一声。而且她也不接电话。

lines.en: : Svarog knows where she is.
lines.zh: Svarog 知道她在哪儿。

lines.en: scene whensummerends15
: Who? Svarog? Is that another one of Ayane’s butlers or something?
lines.zh: 谁？Svarog？那是 Ayane 家的又一个管家什么的吗？

lines.en: : Is what Clara says true, Sir? Do you know what happened to the not-so-friendly neighborhood Lawson employee?
lines.zh: Clara 说的是真的吗，先生？你知道那位不太友善的 Lawson 店员出了什么事吗？

lines.en: scene whensummerends16
: Wait, Yasu was talking about {i}you,{/i} Sensei? Why didn’t you say anything?
lines.zh: 等等，Yasu 说的是{i}你{/i}，Sensei？你为什么不说？

lines.en: : Because I have no idea what happened to her. One second I was talking to her, and the next she was gone.
lines.zh: 因为我完全不知道她出了什么事。上一秒我还在跟她说话，下一秒她就不见了。

lines.en: : Well...do you know which direction she went in? Because, I’m probably just overreacting right now, but I can’t help but feel a little worried.
lines.zh: 那……你知道她往哪个方向走了吗？因为，我可能只是反应过度了，但我还是忍不住有点担心。

lines.en: : I have no idea. Sorry.
lines.zh: 我不知道。抱歉。

lines.en: scene whensummerends17
: Ugh. Gosh darn it. Guess I’ll just try calling the bath house or something.
lines.zh: 唉。真是的。那我大概只能试着打给澡堂什么的了。

lines.en: scene whensummerends18
: While she does that, want to check out some of the stuff I brought you from my stash? I’ve already made sure to screen it for inappropriate content and you’re good to go!
lines.zh: 趁她打电话的时候，想不想看看我从私藏里给你带的东西？我已经提前筛查过，把不适宜的内容都剔掉了，你放心看吧！

lines.en: : Hooray! More pictures!
lines.zh: 万岁！又有图片了！

lines.en: scene whensummerends19
: And for you, Kafka, I’ve uncovered a relatively rare cooking series that I’m quite sure you’ll come to-
lines.zh: 至于你，Kafka，我挖到了一套相当稀有的烹饪系列，我很确定你会-

lines.en: : I will rendezvous with you shortly, Ginger Wolf. I have a matter to take care of with Svarog first.
lines.zh: 我稍后再与你会合，红毛狼。我有一件事要先跟 Svarog 谈。

lines.en: scene whensummerends20
: A side quest? Right now? But we’re already partied up.
lines.zh: 支线任务？现在？可我们已经组队了啊。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo Tojo has left the group.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 已退出队伍。

lines.en: scene whensummerends21
: Kafka?! Tsuneyo?! Where did you go?!
lines.zh: Kafka？！Tsuneyo？！你跑哪儿去了？！

lines.en: : Aaaaaaaaah!
lines.zh: 啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : That should take care of them for a while. Do you have a minute to spare, Sensei? I have something I’d like to ask you.
lines.zh: 这样应该能拖住她们一会儿。Sensei，能占用你一点时间吗？我有件事想问你。

lines.en: scene whensummerends22
: If it’s about what happened in the infirmary, it wasn’t me who-
lines.zh: 如果是关于医务室里发生的事，那不是我-

lines.en: : I have no idea what this is about an infirmary. You just said something earlier that piqued my interest and I have been unsure of how to approach you in regard to it ever since.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道什么医务室。只是你刚才说的话引起了我的兴趣，从那以后我一直不知道该怎么就此事向你开口。

lines.en: : You’re going to have to refresh my memory then, because I have no clue what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: 那你得提醒我一下了，因为我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : The ferris wheel.
lines.zh: 摩天轮。

lines.en: : Why do I have memories of such a thing when we’ve never done something like that before?
lines.zh: 我们从来没做过那种事，为什么我会有这样的记忆？

lines.en: : Because we have.
lines.zh: 因为我们做过。

lines.en: : When? And why do you remember this trip, but I do not? And note that I will not hesitate to cut you down if I discover you drugged or used memory-manipulating magic on me.
lines.zh: 什么时候？为什么你记得这趟行程，而我却不记得？还有，注意，若我发现你对我下药、或使用了操纵记忆的魔法，我会毫不犹豫地将你斩倒。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} didn’t do anything. It’s the world that used “memory magic” or whatever you want to call it. I wanted you to {i}keep{/i} that memory.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}什么都没做。是世界用了「记忆魔法」还是什么，随你怎么叫。我是想让你{i}留下{/i}那段记忆。

lines.en: scene whensummerends23
: I see.
lines.zh: 我明白了。

lines.en: : What do you mean, “I see?” What part of that can you possibly see? It doesn’t make any sense and you should be accusing me of fucking with you right now for even attempting to use that as an explanation.
lines.zh: 你明白什么了？这哪里你能明白？这根本说不通，你该现在就指控我在耍你，就凭我居然敢拿这个当解释。

lines.en: : Perhaps you have just fucked me so many times by now that I have grown used to it? I do not know.
lines.zh: 也许只是因为到如今你已经把我操过太多次，我已经习惯了？我也不知道。

lines.en: scene whensummerends24
: But I can sense you are telling the truth. And the idea that my memories are being somehow altered helps explain why I’ve felt rather unusual as of late.
lines.zh: 但我能感觉到你在说实话。而「我的记忆在某种程度上被改动过」这个说法，恰好能解释为什么我最近感觉相当反常。

lines.en: : Unusual how?
lines.zh: 反常到什么程度？

lines.en: : As in my heart starts beating faster whenever you’re nearby.
lines.zh: 比如只要你一靠近，我的心跳就开始加速。

lines.en: : It’s rather annoying, actually. So if you know how to make that stop, I would greatly appreciate it.
lines.zh: 老实说挺烦人的。所以如果你知道怎么让它停下，我将不胜感激。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: Sensei？

lines.en: : I have no idea how to help with that, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我不知道该怎么帮上忙，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : But I’m sure it will go away on its own.
lines.zh: 但我相信它会自己消失的。

lines.en: scene whensummerends23
: I see.
lines.zh: 我明白了。

lines.en: : Then, are there any concerns you would like to raise to me as well? It is only fair that I address at least one of them as that would account for an equal exchange of emotions between us.
lines.zh: 那么，你这边也有什么想向我提出的顾虑吗？我至少该回应其中一个，这样才算我们之间情绪的对等交换。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : Am I a better person now than I was when you met me?
lines.zh: 比起你刚认识我的时候，我现在是个更好的人了吗？

lines.en: scene whensummerends22
: I am, right?
lines.zh: 我是吧？

lines.en: : Like, don’t get me wrong, I’m still horrible. And I have a million miles to go before I’m worth wasting any amount of words on, but...
lines.zh: 就像，别误会，我还是很糟糕。而且我还要走上一百万英里，才配得上别人为我浪费哪怕一个字，但是……

lines.en: : I’m changing for the better, aren’t I? This isn’t all for nothing. I’m starting to do the right thing and...it’s taking me a while to get there, but...I will.
lines.zh: 我在往好的方向改变，对吧？这一切不是白费的。我开始做对的事了，而且……我还要花点时间才能走到那一步，但是……我会的。

lines.en: : It would be a waste to send me back now, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: 现在就把我送回去，太浪费了吧？

lines.en: : Back to where, Sensei?
lines.zh: 送回哪里去，Sensei？

lines.en: : To...nowhere.
lines.zh: 回到……不知道什么地方。

lines.en: : I don’t really know, to be honest. But you’re not the only one feeling “unusual” right now. It’s just that for me, it’s consuming and replacing every thought I try to think with the idea that this could be the end.
lines.zh: 说实话，我真的不知道。但现在感觉「反常」的不止你一个。只不过对我来说，它正在吞噬并取代我尝试去思考的每一个念头，换上的全都是「这可能就是结局」这个想法。

lines.en: : That {i}I{/i} could be the one to wake up tomorrow with my memories all fucked up instead of any of you.
lines.zh: 明天早上醒来、记忆一片混乱的人，可能就是{i}我{/i}，而不是你们中的任何一个。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but weren’t your memories already “fucked up” to begin with? I’ve heard that time and time again in regard to your past, but I’m not quite sure of the details.
lines.zh: 要是我说错了你纠正我，但你的记忆不是一开始就「乱七八糟」了吗？关于你的过去我听过无数次这种说法，只是我不太清楚细节。

lines.en: : Yeah...they are. Or were. But they’re starting to come back. There are people who are {i}helping{/i} me get them back.
lines.zh: 嗯……是的。或者说曾经是。但它们正在慢慢回来。有人在{i}帮{/i}我找回来。

lines.en: : Then who’s to say those people won’t be there to help you again should you get “fucked up” even more?
lines.zh: 那么谁说得准，万一你变得更「乱七八糟」，那些人不会再来帮你？

lines.en: : Am I using that term correctly? “Fucked up?” That is not sexual in nature as well, is it?
lines.zh: 我这个词用对了吗？「乱七八糟」？这个词也不带性意味吧，是吗？

lines.en: : No, you’re using it correctly. And thank you.
lines.zh: 不，你用对了。还有，谢谢你。

lines.en: : Let’s ride the ferris wheel again if I wake up in my own body tomorrow.
lines.zh: 如果我明天醒来还是自己的身体，我们再坐一次摩天轮吧。

lines.en: scene whensummerends25
: Sensei...
lines.zh: Sensei……

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: 绝对不行。

lines.en: : Wha-
lines.zh: 什-

lines.en: : Hey! Are you ready?
lines.zh: 嘿！准备好了吗？

lines.en: scene whensummerends26
: Ayane? Ready for what?
lines.zh: Ayane？准备什么？

lines.en: : The afterparty thing we talked about earlier. We’re heading over to our usual karaoke place to end the night with a bang.
lines.zh: 就是我们之前说过的那个余兴派对。我们要去常去的那家卡拉 OK，给今晚画个响亮的句号。

lines.en: : Don’t say it like that. He’ll get {i}ideas.{/i}
lines.zh: 别说得这么暧昧。他会{i}想歪{/i}的。

lines.en: : I call shotgun.
lines.zh: 副驾我包了。

lines.en: : We’re just leaving in the middle of the party? We’re not even going to try to sneak away or anything?
lines.zh: 我们就在派对进行到一半直接走？连偷偷溜走都不装一下？

lines.en: : There’s not really any point when things are already starting to wind down. You’re still coming, right?
lines.zh: 反正气氛已经开始冷下来了，没什么意义了。你还是会来的，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. I can come. But, fair warning, I’m still not feeling like my “normal” self.
lines.zh: 我的意思是……嗯。我可以去。不过先说好，我还是没找回「正常」的自己。

lines.en: scene whensummerends27
: That’s fine. I’m kinda tired too. And, if worse comes to worst, you can use my thighs as a pillow and relax while the rest of us sing. As long as you don’t pretend they’re Maya’s, I mean.
lines.zh: 没关系。我也挺累的。而且万一最坏的情况发生，你可以把我的大腿当枕头，我们唱歌的时候你就歇着。只要别假装那是 Maya 的就行。

lines.en: In the midst of all this mental chaos, there was one piece of advice that managed to lure me in.
lines.zh: 在这一片精神混乱之中，有一条建议成功地把我的注意力勾了过去。

lines.en: And strangely enough, it came from {i}Yasu{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: 而奇怪的是，它偏偏来自{i}Yasu{/i}。

lines.en: If this really is the end...and I never make it back to the rooftop...I should spend my final moments with those I cherish, shouldn’t I?
lines.zh: 如果这真的是结局……而我再也回不到天台……那我就该把最后的时光花在我珍视的人身上，不是吗？

lines.en: The girls who stand before me are my everything.
lines.zh: 站在我面前的女孩们是我的一切。

lines.en: They’re the first ones I laid these brand new eyes on and...I’d be happy if they’re the last as well.
lines.zh: 她们是我用这双全新的眼睛最先看到的人，而且……如果她们也是最后看到的，我会很高兴。

lines.en: Besides, there’s still a chance that all those fatalistic thoughts within me spawning like maggots in hot trash are all just...nonsense, right? That I’m making them up?
lines.zh: 再说，我心里那些像热垃圾里的蛆虫一样繁衍的宿命念头，说不定全都只是……胡思乱想，对吧？都是我自己编出来的？

lines.en: This is the final hurdle.
lines.zh: 这是最后一道坎。

lines.en: It’s those most terrible, unspoken urges I have to overcome and conquer if I ever want to become a better me, right?
lines.zh: 如果我想成为更好的自己，就必须克服并征服那些最可怕、说不出口的冲动，对吧？

lines.en: That’s all this is. It’s one more hurdle.
lines.zh: 就只是这样。这只是又一道坎。

lines.en: It’s one more chance for me to be a good boy.
lines.zh: 这只是我再当一次好孩子的机会。

lines.en: And if I can hold out for one more night, they’ll all go away.
lines.zh: 如果我能再撑过这一晚，它们全都会消失。

lines.en: Everything will go away.
lines.zh: 一切都会消失。

lines.en: And I’ll be free to live the happy...{i}quiet{/i} life I’ve always wanted.
lines.zh: 而我就能自由地去过我一直想要的、幸福的……{i}平静{/i}的生活。

lines.en: scene whensummerends28
: Hey...
But could never possibly deserve.
lines.zh: 却永远不可能配得上。

lines.en: : Are we...getting ready to leave?
lines.zh: 我们……准备走了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, hey. Are you feeling better? I was actually just about to come see if you were still up for the trip.
lines.zh: 哦，嘿。你感觉好点了吗？我正准备过去看看你还赶不赶得上去。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m okay now...
lines.zh: 嗯……我现在没事了……

lines.en: : I just needed...a little rest...that’s all...
lines.zh: 我只是需要……休息一下……就这样……

lines.en: : Great! I guess we’re all set, then. Anyone want to go say their final goodbyes, or are we all going to follow in Io’s footsteps and vanish without saying anything?
lines.zh: 太好了！那我们算是都齐了。有人想去道个别吗，还是说我们要跟着 Io 的脚步一声不吭地消失？

lines.en: scene whensummerends29
: Goodbye.
lines.zh: 再见。

lines.en: scene whensummerends30
: Is it just me or was that somehow even worse than leaving without saying anything?
lines.zh: 是我多心，还是这比一声不吭地走掉还要糟？

lines.en: : Is it really okay for you to...leave while everyone else is still here?
lines.zh: 你就这么……在其他人还在这儿的时候走掉，真的好吗？

lines.en: scene black
: It’ll be fine. There’s nothing Geoffrey can’t handle.
lines.zh: 没问题的。没有 Geoffrey 处理不了的事。

lines.en: : What matters most is just getting Sensei out of here undetected before one of the other girls-
lines.zh: 最重要的是在别的女孩发现之前，把 Sensei 神不知鬼不觉地带出去，不然其中一个-

lines.en: : Run!
lines.zh: 快跑！

lines.en: Before I’m able to react, Ami grabs my hand and sprints toward the exit.
lines.zh: 我还没反应过来，Ami 就抓住我的手，朝出口狂奔。

lines.en: And, of course, the entire room takes notice.
lines.zh: 当然，整个房间都注意到了。

lines.en: But, right now...
lines.zh: 但是，现在……

lines.en: I don’t care.
lines.zh: 我不在乎。

lines.en: I don’t care about anything.
lines.zh: 我什么都不在乎。
